International and Commercial Law, LLM

A two-year law degree compressed into four terms, with a dissertation supervised in the final term.

Duration
12 months full-time
Location
Buckingham Campus
Start dates
January and September
Study mode
Full-time

Fees

Home students£16,140 per year

Entry requirements

A second-class honours degree in law or a related discipline. Applicants with professional legal experience are considered individually.

Modules

  • Corporate Governance
  • Dissertation
